corpus_provenance: Authored for this held-out evaluation; not copied from local PGO training or the existing nine-case suite. Upstream model pretraining membership is unknown. Do not use these examples for calibration, tuning, or profiling.

local_training_overlap_check.check: Exact whitespace-normalized prompt/target equality only; not a general contamination test.

tokenization: ChatProtocol generation prefix; target encoded separately without special tokens; no EOS target appended.

model_provenance.candidate_artifact_limitation: External quantized weights/calibration artifacts are not discovered automatically; supply their separate manifest before claiming full candidate reproducibility.

limitations: Small locally authored corpus; not broad capability validation.
Likelihood of one chosen reference does not measure correctness of all valid alternative responses.
Teacher forcing does not measure accumulated free-running errors or long-context behavior.
Do not tune/calibrate on this evaluation corpus. Host scoring/dump overhead is not inference throughput.
rounding_scope: Cross-profile numerical differences are descriptive; no invented tolerance, bit-equality requirement or quality-improvement claim
prefix_cache_policy: none: reset each example, canonical B8 chunks plus B4 tail, separate B1 final prompt/decode
